newsitem.title: FINLAND: Palestinian President Arafat to visit Finland - PLO.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian President Arafat to visit Finland - PLO.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will visit Finland briefly on October 29 on his way to Ireland, the head of the Palestinian delegation in Finland said on Thursday.
"The visit is confirmed," Zuheir Alwazir told Reuters by telephone. He said Arafat would meet Finnish President Martti Ahtisaari in a two-hour stopover between Norway and Ireland.

The foreign ministry could not confirm any details of the planned visit, which Alwazir said was due to strong links between Arafat and Ahtisaari and the attention Ahtisaari has paid to the peace process in the Middle East.
